carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a high-luminance dorsal edge transitioning into a shadowed ventral gradient extending anteriorly from the dorsal fin base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A metallic ring is pierced through the anterior-basal margin of the first dorsal fin as part of a tethering system.
other_distinctive_markers: An orange and red electronic telemetry tag is attached to the dorsal fin, featuring a trailing antenna with two yellow markers.
